info.name: Rayls Privacy Ops API
info.description:
Collection for the Rayls Privacy Ops API (v1.4). Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server address (default: http://localhost:8080).

Auth flow:
1. Bootstrap the first admin via POST /admin/bootstrap
2. Login via SIWE or OAuth
3. On success, a JWT cookie is set and a `refresh_token` is returned in the body
4. Use `POST /auth/refresh` to rotate the token pair

variable.description: Refresh token received after successful authentication. Used to rotate the JWT.

request.description: Returns the health status of the API.

One-time endpoint to create the first admin user and provision an HSM wallet.

Returns 201 with the wallet address on success.
Returns 409 BOOTSTRAP_ALREADY_COMPLETED if any user already exists.

Protected at the network/infra level — no auth required.
Step 1 of SIWE flow. Returns a nonce and a SIWE message (EIP-4361) to be signed by the wallet.

exec: // JWT is set as a cookie — Postman captures it automatically.
// To use it as a Bearer token in non-browser clients, read the JWT cookie value.

request.description:
Step 2 of SIWE flow. Verifies the signed SIWE message.

Decision tree (v1.4):
- New wallet → auto-registers user → 403 WALLET_REGISTERED
- Account suspended → 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
- Awaiting role → 403 ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_PENDING
- Role assigned + no on-chain roles → 403 ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_PENDING
- Role assigned + has roles → 200 { status, refresh_token, user }

On success: JWT is set as a cookie, refresh_token is returned in the body.
Revokes the refresh token and clears the JWT cookie.

Initiates the Google OAuth flow. Open this URL in a browser — it will redirect to Google's consent screen.

Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to be configured.

On success: JWT cookie set + 200 { status, refresh_token, user }.
On pending role: 403 ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_PENDING. On an email already used by another provider: 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_LINKED.

Initiates the Microsoft OAuth flow. Open this URL in a browser — it will redirect to Microsoft's consent screen.

Requires MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET to be configured.

On success: JWT cookie set + 200 { status, refresh_token, user }.
On pending role: 403 ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_PENDING. On an email already used by another provider: 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_LINKED.

Validates the refresh token, checks user eligibility and on-chain roles, then rotates the token pair.

Returns a new JWT (as cookie) and a new refresh_token (in body). The old refresh_token is blacklisted.

Errors:
- 401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN — token invalid or expired
- 401 TOKEN_REVOKED — token already used
- 401 INVALID_USER_STATUS — account suspended
- 401 NO_ACTIVE_ROLES — roles revoked on-chain
- 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE — blockchain RPC unavailable
Revokes the refresh token and clears the JWT cookie. Safe to call even with an expired token.

Returns the authenticated user's profile: id, name, email, picture, roles, and wallet address.

Requires a valid JWT cookie and the PRIVACY_NODE_OPERATOR role.

Errors:
- 401 — missing or invalid JWT
- 403 — authenticated but missing PRIVACY_NODE_OPERATOR role
- 500 — failed to fetch user or wallet from DB
Opens the Swagger UI for interactive API documentation.
